scope: Repair and bounded learning validation, not a new full P1 or P2
shutdown: Previous shutdown controller cancelled for this new active task; no automatic shutdown during validation
correction: The old CTHA window had at most 46 mixed groups and 152 actual pairs; Progress 52 groups and 171 pairs. The design was not mathematically impossible for every possible rollout, but failed to activate on all actual rounds.
cold_start: P0 frozen train-only trajectories, namespaced iteration IDs, leave-task-type-out predictions. Prior P0 gate success is known and cannot be called new independent evidence. Report current-policy gate separately.

optimizer.reference: frozen original base via adapter disabling
optimizer.batch_population: all response steps including zero advantage; same denominator and optimizer schedule

stages: CPU regression and offline gate feasibility
same frozen base repeated generation with exact prompts/seeds and stored processed sampling logprobs
bounded positive/negative update direction on actual saved samples
step-zero tune evaluation on all 40 games x 2 fixed seeds
four rounds each of GRPO and GiGPO style on fixed first 16 train games x 4 reps, shared initial rollout
evaluate training-task learning and paired tune change; no enlargement if not demonstrated
success_interpretation: Engineering gates do not establish generalization. Report fixed-seed train success changes and game-cluster bootstrap CIs on tune. No declaration of algorithmic benefit without a positive paired lower 95% bound. A failed check is retained and stops downstream work. Repairs require a new version/output namespace, never relaxed gates or overwritten outputs.
revision: New namespace after BF16 and FP16 parity failures. Fresh on-policy rollouts, FP32 HF and vLLM with tf32x3 Triton dot and num_stages=1. No thresholds or training objective changed.

acceptance_states.engineering: all prior guards and checkpoint chain passed
acceptance_states.learning: positive paired train change and game-cluster lower 95% bound >0, one-seed pilot only
acceptance_states.generalization: positive paired tune change and game-cluster lower 95% bound >0, one-seed pilot only

precision.vllm_lora: disabled; ephemeral FP32 merged checkpoint for sampling only

reuse: No old BF16 behavioral records reused as FP32 on-policy training samples. Old records retained.
